critiques.action: Add a recessed binding strip and attach the flap hinge to the right leaf plane.
critiques.comparison: Compare physical connection and crease shadow against this open-folio revision, without changing lighting or samples.
critiques.evidence: The two leaves are disconnected and the dark triangular tab stands above the right face.

observations: Two facing paper leaves now read as an open folio. The central gap separates them, and the dark dogear looks like a loose tab floating above the right leaf rather than a connected fold.
user_feedback: Retain the warm matte finish; no request for added gloss.
